evidence: A commenter enjoyed the book and praises its accessible, entertaining history, including metro construction.

evidence_sources.author: atourgates
evidence_sources.excerpt: If you're traveling to or interested in Paris and its history, I really enjoyed "Parisians: An Adventure History of Paris" by Graham Robb. Has some good, accessible and entertaining history relating to (among other things) the construction of the metro.

source_story_title: Blaise Pascal invented fixed route public transport (2024)
